categories.name: Pothole or road damage
categories.definition: Damage to the public road carriageway or its surface.
exclude: standing water with no stated road damage

categories.name: Garbage or waste
categories.definition: Uncollected, dumped, overflowing or improperly handled solid waste in a public place.

categories.name: Streetlight
categories.definition: A fault affecting public street or pathway lighting equipment.

categories.name: Waterlogging
categories.definition: Standing or accumulated water obstructing a public road, footpath or open public space.
exclude: a drain defect that is the primary reported issue

categories.name: Broken footpath
categories.definition: Damage or missing elements on a public pedestrian footpath or pavement.

categories.name: Drainage or sewerage
categories.definition: A defect, blockage, opening or overflow involving public drains, manholes or sewerage.
exclude: standing rainwater with no drain defect identified
solid waste not involving a drain

categories.name: Water leakage
categories.definition: Unintended escape of clean or supply water from public water infrastructure.

categories.name: Other eligible civic issue
categories.definition: An in-scope non-emergency urban civic issue that does not fit the seven named categories.
include: eligible municipal public-space issue outside taxonomy v1
exclude: records too unclear to establish an eligible issue
